data.title: TRON Is Earning More Than Ethereum and Solana Combined. Why Is TRX Worth So Much Less?
data.description: TRON now generates more transaction fee revenue than Ethereum and Solana put together, yet TRX trades at a fraction of their prices. The reason why reveals something uncomfortable about what crypto markets actually reward.
